author: bfonta
body:
Extends the HLT and offline MET validation, including MHT collections and generator-level MHT, plus MET-vs-MHT comparisons, plus HLT vs offline comparisons. Important restructure of  `METTester` + post-processing and harvesting, now also covering MHT. The plotting-script was also updated.                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                        
Tested with [QCD](https://bfontana.web.cern.ch/bfontana/MET_Valid_2ndRound/QCD/) and [Wprime](https://bfontana.web.cern.ch/bfontana/MET_Valid_2ndRound/Wprime/) samples (HLT), for instance:

```bash
NEVENTS=10
GEOM="ExtendedRun4D128"
ERA="Phase2C26I13M9"
CONDS="auto:phase2_realistic_T35"
VALIDSEQ="@hltValidation"
HLTSEQ="75e33" # NGTScouting

function mystep2() {
    cmsDriver.py step2 -s L1P2GT,HLT:"${HLTSEQ}",DQM:trackingMonitorHLT,VALIDATION:"${VALIDSEQ}" \
				 --conditions "${CONDS}" \
				 --datatier GEN-SIM-DIGI-RAW,DQMIO \
				 -n ${NEVENTS} \
				 --eventcontent FEVTDEBUGHLT,DQMIO \
				 --geometry "${GEOM}" \
				 --era "${ERA}" \
				 --customise SLHCUpgradeSimulations/Configuration/aging.customise_aging_1000 \
				 --filein file:/eos/cms/store/relval/CMSSW_20_0_0_patch1/RelValWprimeToLNu_M2000_14TeV/GEN-SIM-DIGI-RAW/PU_150X_mcRun4_realistic_v1_STD_D128_RegeneratedGS_PU_16Aug26-v2/2590000/feacc96a-1105-475a-8c26-4ea4e0d00354.root \
				 --fileout file:step2_fix.root \
				 --nThreads 24 \
				 --hltProcess HLTX \
				 --processName HLTX \
				 --inputCommands='keep *, drop *_hlt*_*_HLT, keep *_hltParticleFlowTmpBarrel_*_*, drop triggerTriggerFilterObjectWithRefs_l1t*_*_HLT' \
				 --outputCommands='keep *_hltParticleFlowTmpBarrel_*_HLTX, keep *_hltParticleFlowTmp_*_HLTX'
}

function mystep3() {
    cmsDriver.py step3 -s HARVESTING:"${VALIDSEQ}" \
				 --conditions "${CONDS}" \
				 --mc \
				 --geometry "${GEOM}" \
				 --scenario pp \
				 --filetype DQM \
				 --era "${ERA}" \
				 -n ${NEVENTS} \
				 --hltProcess HLTX \
				 --filein file:step2_fix_inDQM.root \
				 --fileout file:step3_fix.root
}

mystep2 && mystep3
```

Similar plots are available for offline collections [here](https://bfontana.web.cern.ch/bfontana/MET_Valid_Offline/).

Based on [this presentation](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1698231/#sc-2-6-phase-2-central-validat).

Data samples used:
+ QCD: `/eos/cms/store/relval/CMSSW_20_1_0_pre3/RelValQCD_FlatPt_15_3000HS_14/GEN-SIM-DIGI-RAW/PU_150X_mcRun4_realistic_v1_STD_D128_RegeneratedGS_PU_20260903_192421_RV19-v1/2830000`
+ Wprime: `/eos/cms/store/relval/CMSSW_20_1_0_pre3/RelValWprimeToLNu_M2000_14TeV/GEN-SIM-DIGI-RAW/PU_150X_mcRun4_realistic_v1_STD_D128_RegeneratedGS_PU_20260903_192421_RV19-v1/2830000/`
title: Extend and restructure the MET and MHT validation
